proposedFixedConfiguration.clock: Fixture clock/IDs must be frozen before comparison; never mask actual effect/status/history
proposedFixedConfiguration.fontReady: Require exact bundled font load, resolve font faces and hash rendered font assets at capture
proposedFixedConfiguration.motion: reducedMotion reduce; safety surfaces no decorative animation
proposedFixedConfiguration.renderer: Record actual browser executable SHA, rendering backend/GPU/flags, OS update, Playwright version and emitted build/asset hashes before baseline run

proposedComparison.comparison: Compare two captures from the SAME deterministic fixture/build/environment; no comparison result claimed for saved historical captures
proposedComparison.baseline: New owner-approved ephemeral functional regression baseline. Existing 746 candidate references remain design review context; they are not promoted automatically.
proposedComparison.mismatchRule: Any pixel mismatch fails automated comparison and goes to named Design/QA review. Correct fixture/render noise or approved implementation defect; do not silently raise tolerance or mask actions/context/history/privacy.
proposedComparison.reviewRule: Review every failed diff and route/state association in AR/EN with original/candidate/diff and recorded disposition. Baseline changes require explicit bounded owner decision.
